cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm taking you to lunch, just us. That family reunion was a disaster we needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. No audience this time. I'll get us something to eat; you start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Start? You haven't even asked what I want to eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, I'll put my menu down. Order yours first; mine can wait.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 frames the failed reunion as needed; A3 removes the audience and manages lunch; A5 yields ordering control to retain B participation. The lesson is enacted rather than restated.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 describes the failure that informs A3 smaller setting; B4 objects to being ordered for and causes A5 to wait.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants a say in the actual meal, not to supply a headcount for a lesson.

heightening.evidence: A5 changes A management of the meal in response to a live example of the old overriding habit.

specificity.evidence: A1 lunch and B2 failed reunion supply all context; A5 menu is an ordinary restaurant object, not an unexplained booking change.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 is a short concession with an executable request; it no longer adds a thematic closing speech.
